review: Hotel Marina offers free outdoor guest parking at Vedbæk Strandvej 391. Register the vehicle on the APCOA tablet at reception; the hotel’s arrival information also confirms that reception-tablet registration is required.

The recorded accommodation payment was 5,728.46 kr for five nights, including taxes and fees after a booking credit. This works out to an average of 1,145.69 kr per night. The supplied receipt labels the currency only as “kr”, so no SEK or DKK currency code has been assumed.
Free parking makes Marina a useful addition to the parking shortlist. No separate parking payment is recorded. A broader assessment of the room, service and other facilities has not been supplied.
reviews.sourceNote: Accommodation payment taken from a supplied receipt. APCOA tablet procedure reported by the guest; free outdoor parking and registration at reception confirmed on the official hotel website on 24 October 2026. Personal and booking details are omitted.

reviews.name: Scandic Elmia
reviews.summary: Satisfactory overnight stay at a fair room price.
review: Scandic Elmia provided a satisfactory overnight stay at a fair room price of SEK 1,107. Parking cost a further SEK 105, bringing the recorded total for the room and parking to SEK 1,212.
Parking was paid separately through Pair Parking’s website, where the parking receipt was also available. On this stay, the parking charge could not be included on the hotel receipt.

The room price was reasonable. The additional parking cost and separate receipt should be taken into account when comparing alternatives, particularly for business travel. This stay does not qualify for the free-parking shortlist.
reviews.sourceNote: Personal stay report recorded 24 October 2026. The hotel name and address were checked against the official Scandic and Pair booking pages. Prices, assessment and receipt arrangements describe this stay; they are not a current tariff or a statement of permanent hotel policy.
